notes.title: Return to the ash-choked streets of Wight Chapel.
notes.notes:
Its time to go back, hunter.

The madness of Pattic Claine is not finished with you yet.  Five missing Galvanic horrors await you in the ash-clogged lanes and crematoria of Wight Chapel.  Conclude the mystery in Grindwheel Games' first two-part adventure.  Can you face the nightmare once again and escape with your sanity intact?

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Face the Crawling Horror of Wight Chapel...if you dare!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Wight Chapel, rookie.

How well did you handle the challenge?  Find out in Wight Chapel Dreams – the sixth instalment in The Hunter's Journals series!

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: The TATTERED SAILS have been sighted!
notes.notes:
IT COMES...

The TATTERED SAILS have been sighted on the horizon.  Something unearthly moves through the fog like a ponderous colossi.  The stars wheel overhead.  Portents are bleak.

Can YOU stand against it?

Plunge into an investigation which sees you journey deep into The Grass Sea in search of treasure, only to find horror and death.  This latest case has a lot of subtle pathways which can guide you to AN ending.  But will it see the evil vanquished for good, or just sent back for a while?  Only your choices can decide the outcome.

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Grindwheel Games and Sanguine Productions 2: Abyss!
notes.notes:
Grindwheel Games and Sanguine Productions have joined forces once again for their latest Kickstarter - Abyss!  A supernatural pen-and-paper RPG in which you play heroes who fight terrible monsters from beyond the realm of nightmares.

The game's description is as follows:

"The world has secrets in remote corners. Horrors from out of time. Devils that are out for blood. Monsters that feed upon the helpless, in ways beyond mortal understanding. Only a select few have the knowledge or the power to fight the supernatural, and the responsibility to protect the innocent falls upon your shoulders.

But within every heart lurks a shadow. The forces that cultivate hate, that prey upon greed, that induce fear and terror... they are not just out there, they are within you. Can you fight with monsters without becoming one yourself?"

The project can be found here https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sanguine/abyss-the-tabletop-rpg-of-supernatural-action-horror , and as part of the backing options you can pick to add one of the Grindwheel Games titles to your order as an extra.  There are plenty of other stretch goals too, so please give them your support!

notes.title: Spooky Tales for the Winter Sales!
notes.notes:
As with last year, I will be posting a piece of short fiction and an unreleased page image in time for the holidays.  From now on, however, this will happen with the Winter Sale, when all Grindwheel Game products can participate in the promotion.  Please enjoy the story, and have a great holiday season!

[b]The Token
[/b]
Amton hurried through the filthy streets, doing his best to avoid the Inquisitors and any desperate enough to kill him over the package he carried.  His hands tightened around the pitiful bundle of meat, tucking it closer to his rags.  As the oldest of the gang, it was his duty to deliver this year's token.  With starvation and plague stalking the Low City of Roche Divine, they needed all the help they could get.

He ducked into a doorway without pausing.  Speed would be key to his survival now.  The dead, still air hung heavily as he approached the desk.  He knew the ritual, whispered about by gang leaders and derelicts alike.  He came to a stop, one hand hovering over the tarnished bell as the other kept a tight hold on the old beggar's severed foot.

He slapped his palm down on the bell.  Ding!  The sound of it echoed through the hollow, seemingly abandoned structure.  Now he had to move again.  His heartbeat thudded in his ears as he raced for the steps.  Up he went, two at a time, while he fumbled in his pouch for the little, metal token.  The words 'Bread, Please' were crudely scratched into the surface.  He jammed it into the severed ankle as he reached the landing, just as he had been told.

He froze for an instant, scanning the darkness for threats, then began to make his way down the row of empty room.  The stench was overpowering, but he had to get as far along as possible.  Everyone in the district knew that the higher the room number you dumped your offering into, the more likely your prayer was to be heard.  He passed the halfway point and hesitated.  Surely this would be enough?

Something shifted in the darkness ahead, and Amton could not make himself go a step further.  His bravery faltered, and he tossed his offering into the closest room, where it thudded down onto a pile of remains thankfully obscured in darkness.  He turned...and stopped dead.  They were already behind him.

His brief, terrified scream was ignored by the peasants in the street.

notes.title: Red Ripper is Live!

The Hunter's Journals - Red Ripper is now available to play on Steam, with the Android version coming later today.  The most challenging hunt to date is waiting in the rotting, decadent city of Roche Divine.  Can YOU discover the secrets of the Red Ripper?  Can you beat them?  Can you even survive the tangles streets of the Low City with your mind and body intact?

We shall see...

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 6
notes.notes:
Red Ripper is proving to be one of the toughest challenges in the series to date.  As such, it is very likely that you will see the general death page many, many times before you defeat the terrible evil facing the Sunlight Alliance.  As with previous releases, the final page previewed before the game goes live is the death art, which you can find below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/b43fb93fee0b63dfa55927e5871da6a1a2306987.jpg[/img]

While not an official part of The Stasis, if a person of note dies they are often commemorated with a small shrine or ossuary where they fell.  This means they remain dead in the same place, this preserving continuity in future years.  As a visitor to the Sunlight Alliance, you will be afforded this dubious honour...even though you are a godless heathen in the eyes of the sainted nobility.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 5
notes.notes:
Here is the penultimate Red Ripper page, and the last of the general art images.  After this there is is only...death.  Followed, of course, by the release of the game.  Dare you brave this darkness to face the Red Ripper?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/27be89fd0c4b7463314153f769f2d3cf561251d9.jpg[/img]

Darkness quickly becomes a constant in a hunter's life.  Few of their foes lurk in the bright light of day, or move among the regular folk on the surface.  It was for this reason that, when the Hunter's Clubs were initially formalised, several voices called for their members to be named 'Torchbearers' or 'Light-Bringers'.  In the end these titles were dropped, although it is still the duty of the hunters to bring the light of reason to the darkest of places.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 4
notes.notes:
With a little under a week to go before Halloween, and the release of The Hunter's Journals - Red Ripper, here is the latest of the general art pages for people to enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/b27654a0d4e1b4c9cc4ad55f793f2a28598cacf5.jpg[/img]

Roche Divine embodies the terrible dichotomy of the the Sunlight Alliance.  In the halls of the Sainted Nobility, everything is of the highest quality, gilded excessively and polished to a high sheen.  This luxury is only maintained by the majority of the populace living in conditions of utter, abject poverty.  The worst part is that, thanks to centuries of The Stasis, the people not only believe this to be their natural state, but actively oppose any attempt to improve their lot.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 3
notes.notes:
Grindwheel Games welcomes you to the weekend with the third general page image from the upcoming Red Ripper.  We hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/1c59b5f4d07c2966173e8214c71fda4ca99100c3.jpg[/img]

Compasses are a rare sight in the Sunlight Alliance, as there is little need for them.  Under The Stasis, people are either expected to stay put, or the symbolic journey they must take is already so well known to them such tools are not needed.  Surviving examples are traded on the black market by members of the Heretics, and possession of one is considered suspicious by the Inquisitors.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 2
notes.notes:
Good morning!  It is Wednesday, which means it is time for another art page to be released.  Please enjoy the image and lore below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/71283487186008b342ebe391f17dc16c0ab348d9.jpg[/img]

It is, perhaps, a testament to the skill and artistry of the pre-Stasis Alliance that so many mundane objects have survived the ravages of time.  This doll, for example, was fabricated at the renowned Herballien boutique some time before the Sunset Rebellion.  The workers at the present factory are barely able to produce simple rag figures due to both a shortage of materials and poor training.  But, as dictated by The Stasis, they must continue to churn out such shoddy work as if their very souls depend on it.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 1
notes.notes:
The Hunter's Journals - Red Ripper releases on Halloween.  With a little over a fortnight to go, it is time to preview the amazing in-game artwork by Muthur Brine, and build the lore of the sinister place you will be visiting.  Please enjoy the first page below, and be ready for more to follow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/4a41d8aa6763f0cc641cd3b9b83c2d067adea730.jpg[/img]

Items crafted before the imposition of The Stasis are considered by the Sunlight Alliance to be almost divine in nature.  Here we see a single bead from a ceremonial rosary, which has been strung on a cord made of ancient threads.  The peasants of the Alliance believe such trinkets bring great fortune and divine favour.

notes.title: Red Ripper Fixes and Rebalance
notes.notes:
A new version of Red Ripper has been uploaded, with a small number of bug fixes as well as some rebalancing tweaks.

On the bug front, a couple of fights were not setting the correct variables to show they had been completed, meaning they could be encountered over and over again.  As one of them led to a Skill loss, this was hardly a great situation!  These, as well as some other minor issues have been corrected in the new build.

In addition, Red Ripper has proven to be even tougher than anticipated.  As such, two of the achievements have been reworked.  First, the Underdog level for this game has been raised to 9.  Not only will this make it slightly easier to travel the perilous roads of the city in general, but a Max Skill of 9 is more likely to appear in the intermediate game level when your statistics are generated.  As such, you can start with several more Medical Kits to see you through the game.

Secondly, one of the hidden achievements involved beating the game carrying an item which made combat significantly harder.  This was found to be far too tricky, and so has been reworked into something more achievable.

Red Ripper is due out on Halloween as planned, and with this valuable feedback from playtesters should prove to be a less frustrating experience for the spooky season.

notes.title: The Heirloom System
notes.notes:
As mentioned in the trailer for Red Ripper, from this game onward all Hunter's Journals titles will allow you to take an item with you on your travels.  These range from weapons to armour to more unique artefacts.  All of them take up a slot in your inventory, meaning that you may be pressed for space if you are trying to take every item you encounter with you.  They also all have a positive impact on the game mechanics, balanced by either requiring unique circumstances to activate, or presenting a handicap in some situations.

  In The Hunters Journals - Tattered Sails, this will be paired with the Trait system, allowing you to combine your Hunter's quirks and foibles with the Heirlooms to create a truly individual character.

  Today, I will be posting the details of the Heirlooms available below, and adding a discussion to the community page so people can debate the pros and cons of the various items.  This will also be done when Tattered Sails is coming up for release, letting fans discuss the various combinations which will arise from the two systems interacting.

[h1]Heirlooms:
[/h1]

[b]Nothing[/b] - Not every hunter has access to rare equipment, and some shun these fancy gadgets in order to retain the purity of the hunt.  Some have also fallen on hard times, and have sold their beloved equipment in order to live in a style to which they have become accustomed.  Which are you?

[b]Effects[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Empty Pockets[/b] – You gain no bonuses, but also do not give up an equipment slot.  Keep reminding yourself that a bowl is most useful when it is empty.
[/list]

[b]Brutal Hunter Set[/b] – Some hunters rely on sheer, raw damage to win the day.  This option means your hunter has a wickedly serrated blade and a powerful handgun loaded with flesh-shredding Hunter's Shot rounds.  So armed, they can bludgeon down any foe with spectacular overkill.

[b]Effects[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Crippling Damage[/b] – You deal 1 extra point of damage in combat.
[*][b] Overspecialised[/b] – You no longer win drawn combat rounds, automatically losing the round instead.
[/list]

[b]Precise Hunter Set[/b] – Instead of relying on brute force to best their foes, some hunters rely on skill.  You are one such hunter, and carry a devilishly sharp rapier and carefully sighted duelling pistol.  With these weapons, you can constantly out-class your enemies and land a series of hits that will leave them reeling.

[b]Effects[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Rain of Blows[/b] – You adds 1 to your dice rolls in combat.
[*] [b]Overspecialised[/b] – You no longer win drawn combat rounds, automatically losing the round instead.
[/list]

[b]Witch-Silver Weapons[/b] – While enchanted weapons are rare, some hunters do carry them.  The swirling inlay of witch-silver on your sword and pistol means that they can deal lasting damage to creatures not of this world.  The wounds they cause also fester and seethe, making a mockery of most beast's powers of regeneration.

[b]Effects[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Baleful Enchantments[/b] – Enemies cannot regenerate, ignore or reduce damage dealt by these weapons.
[*] [b]Night Terrors[/b] – Even the presence of small amounts of witch-silver cause violent nightmares.  Despite the protective case you keep them in, your hunter will suffer from these as long as they carry the weapons.  You regain no lost Skill when you sleep.
[/list]

[b]Heraldic Breastplate[/b] – Most hunters skip wearing this cumbersome item except when facing particularly deadly foes.  It hinders the movement of the wearer, but does result in an additional level of protection that can mean the difference between life and death.

[b]Effects[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Hardened Protection[/b] – The toughened steel of the breastplate means you have a 50% chance to reduce all damage (including damage sustained outside of combat) by 1, to a minimum of 1.
[*] [b]Cumbersome[/b] – Using this item restricts your movement, meaning you must subtract 1 from your dice roll in combat.
[/list]

[b]Toughened Leathers[/b] – Some hunters choose to add a few extra layers of leather to their gear, as well as brass or steel studs at the shoulders and hips.  These precautions help to deflect incoming attack from your blind spots, at the cost of reduced mobility and extra weight.

[b]Effects[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Backstab Insurance[/b] – The extra protection of the toughened leather means that you cannot take automatic damage in combat.  IE – any enemy that inflicts damage 'regardless of the combat result' loses this ability against a hunter with this item.
[*] [b]Cumbersome[/b] – Using this item restricts your movement, meaning you must subtract 1 from your dice roll in combat.
[/list]

[b]Light Armour[/b] – Not every hunter places their faith in thick leather and steel.  Hunters who take this option have stripped down their protective layers to the bare minimum.  This allows them to keep one step ahead of all but the most ferocious enemies.  Of course, should they be caught out, it could spell disaster...

[b]Effects[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Swashbuckling Skills[/b] – All enemies must reduce their dice roll by 1 in combat against you.
[*] [b]Glass Cannon[/b] – All enemies inflict 1 extra point of damage in combat against you.
[/list]

[b]Punch Dagger[/b] – Some hunters train to use a punch dagger strapped to their pistol hand to aid them in combat.  The chance to use such an exotic weapon comes once in a blue moon, but when an opportunity appears the unexpected attack can be deadly.

[b]Effects[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Scorpion Stab[/b] – If the result of a combat round is a draw, you not only win the round, but deal an additional 4 points of damage.
[/list]

[b]Beloved Locke[/b]t – A hunter's life is often lonely.  Those lucky enough to have a romantic attachment of some sort tend to carry a keepsake with them wherever they are far from home.  No matter how daunting the hunt, they can always use it as a touchstone when they dream of the life they will go back to when it is all over.

[b]Effects[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Sweet Dreams, My Love[/b] – When you sleep, you regain 1 extra point of skill and 2 extra points of stamina.
[/list]

[b]Lucky Pocketwatch[/b] – While not always a pocketwatch, the logic of this item remains the same.  By placing a small, metal object over their heart, the hunter hopes that fate will intervene and block a lethal blow.  It happens more often than you think, although usually not more than once for a single person.

[b]Effects[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Fate Averted [/b]– The first time you would be slain because you lost a round of combat, this item is destroyed instead.  Any further damage taken that round will then be applied as normal.
[/list]

notes.title: Red Ripper Store Page Live!
notes.notes:
The Hunter's Journals - Red Ripper is coming this Halloween!

The latest book in the series, and the hardest challenge the hunter faces to date, will be released on Halloween 2020.  Trawl the depths of the rotting city of Roche Divine in search of the Red Ripper, a Broadsheet Killer who's trail of victims is so large that even the theocratic rulers of the Sunlight Alliance could not cover them up.

Thankfully, you will be able to take a powerful item with you on your hunt thanks to the new Heirloom system.  This lets you sacrifice a slot in your inventory for a weapon set, some armour, or more exotic gear.  With this you might stand a chance of hunting down and slaying your quarry...  All of the games will contain this system from now on, allowing you to personalise YOUR hunter and play style.

News and updates will come as the game gets ready for launch, including the same game-art countdown as with Pale Harbour, Vile Philosophy and Blissful Ignorance.  Stay tuned for a teaser trailer in the coming weeks too!
